business_problem: predict system failures and diagnose incidents from millions of events and alerts before outages affect client operations.
solution_summary: Ensono uses Snowflake and Streamlit in Snowflake on Snowflake to predict system failures and diagnose incidents from millions of events and alerts before outages affect client operations. Operational events and alerts from Ensono-managed systems are centralized in Snowflake so predictive models can detect risk patterns earlier. The Envision Predictive Engine scores those signals to identify high-risk conditions, while the DiagnoseNow application presents AI-assisted root-cause analysis and incident context to responders. Frontline operations teams use the Streamlit interface to review diagnoses quickly, cut resolution time, and prevent outages before they impact client environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and applications. Ensono reduced major incidents by 30%, improved SLA performance by 38%, cut mean time to resolution by 54-70%,...
